{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the clean
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check if any revenue is 999999.99 (internal test orders)
print("Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99:", (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
